reviews.title: Great app if want to into self-love
reviews.text: This app is not only great to make you reflect or be “grateful” about everything around but it makes shine does little moments you may forgotten about. The prompts for writing are great, but my favorite part is the quotes from the daily zen; really on point, not the typical says we heard before a thousand times a day and I like the you can this like widgets too without the pro version. So to the developers keep making this app great but don’t forget about users who use the free version

reviews.title: Awesome for this adhd brain
reviews.text:
I have a stack of gratitude journals, as most ADHD’ers would likely agree that 99% are empty. This app allows me to document my gratitude daily without forgetting, and offers numerous gratitude tools with the paid version. I find that my days are typically better when I start the day with gratitude. This app makes it so easy. 
I downloaded this a few weeks ago, when I was starting in a hotel after I had an electrical fire at my home from a lightning strike; we were lucky, I was able to isolate the overheating wires, there’s was a fire that erupted in front of me… that I smothered with the nearest thing, blackout curtains, and ran to shut off the breaker box.
Dealing with the insurance company became so overwhelming that I was looking for any way to better the situation. That’s when I downloaded this app. Thank you to the creators of it.

reviews.title: Can’t delete 🫪
reviews.text:
I’ve deleted this app many times, and it keeps coming back. Every. Single. Day. I’m not sure how you could mess up so badly that your app is acting as a sort of virus, but I (and at least a few others) would really appreciate it if you’d make it your top priority to fix it. It’s a good app, sure, but not so good that I should be forced to have it downloaded… Do something about this. I beg.
Update: A month later, the app is still redownloading daily, even after a software update. I’m starting to loathe y’all at this point.

reviews.title: I’m humbled
reviews.text: This app has become an important part to the start of my day. It helps me to stay grounded and appreciative. There is so much going on with the outside world. I need ways to keep peace on the inside. I recommend this app to my clients.  My only feedback is to get more varied prompts. It seems they recycle and no need for repeats. There’s plenty to be inspired by. Incorporate the senses, colors, textures, etc., for the prompts. If I miss a day with the version I have, I can go back a day or two which is nice. Overall a GREAT app.
